blinding_note: Model, workflow name, tokens, runtimes and tool traces are withheld. Reviewers must disclose if report content still reveals the method.
objective: Reconstruct inline and offline observations with time alignment, original values and cell-level provenance; report unresolved mappings.

report.assessment: Reconstruction of the scoped evidence package (12 workbooks, 24 runs, 8 sheets and 56 series per run) is complete at the structure level: every series carries an elapsed-hours clock starting at 0, inline streams are dense (~30-60 s sampling, 10^4-4x10^4 rows) and offline assays are sparse (7-23 sampling rows), and all 1,344 series were screened through the deterministic preparation artifact. Inline-to-offline time alignment was demonstrated on four representative runs: offline samples map exactly (0.0 h offset) or within 15 s onto inline records in clock-clean runs (EXP001/R01 14/15 exact; EXP001/R02 14/15 exact; EXP010/R01 21 nearest + 1 exact + 1 ambiguous 30 s-grid tie at t=169 h); unmatched samples occur only where inline streams end before the final offline sample (~5.7 h tail in EXP001, where ProcessParameters continues to 207.2 h but Permittivity/CO2 stop at 201.26 h). Mapping obstructions are now characterized rather than just flagged: (1) all 195 backwards source-time steps in the seven flagged inline series are exactly 30 s with no clock re-base, confined to the permittivity/turbidity export files (CO2/ProcessParameters clocks strictly monotonic), with one ~40-row descending staircase per EXP003 run (~141.4-141.9 h) adjacent to a verified 6-row zero dropout in EXP003/R01 that captured the offline t=142 h sample under nearest matching; no offline sample falls inside an inversion window, so >= ~2 min tolerances remain safe, but time-sorted preprocessing would silently reverse the EXP003 blocks. (2) EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 carry zero-filled Cole-fit channels (18 C frequencies, Alpha, DeltaEps, fit RMSE/R2, fc all 0.0; verified cell U24151=0) while Conductivity/Permittivity stay live and offline VCD still aligns 14/15 exactly - a per-run fitting/export gap removing frequency-resolved mapping only. (3) The screening 200-percent paired-peak flags on EXP003/EXP004/EXP005 are statistic artifacts (zero fit outputs; an all-negative series whose maximum is the 0-valued first row; a sign-inverted Reflection channel verified at cells C1737=0 vs C1471=0.110363). (4) Batch runs (EXP001-009) show constant-zero feed and a never-accumulating NaOH channel (EXP001/R02: -0.13/+0.09 g, 40 percent negative) consistent with batch operation, while fed-batch runs show live feed trajectories (verified EXP010/R01 857.3 g); EXP011/R02's feed log stops at t=67.14 h at 11.42 g (vs 228.53 g in R01) and its offline glucose stops at the same t=67 h - absent cells, not measured zeros, cause unresolved. (5) Endpoint zeros in EXP009/R01 aeration O2 and EXP010/R02 CO2 inlet are recorded control states (zero for >= 4.6-5.2 h in fully populated final rows), not log-endpoint fills. (6) EXP011/R02 shows a progressive terminal viability collapse (VCD and viability 0 at five consecutive offline samples t=148.5-195 h with TCD 5.83M at the end and 100*VCD/TCD matching recorded viability; R01 cross-check 9.42 vs 9.47 percent), paralleled less extremely in EXP001/R01 (VCD 46,000, viability 0.28 percent, TCD 16.5M at t=207 h); replicate-level counts remain unavailable. Remaining work: per-run alignment for the other 20 runs, clock characterization for EXP004 (40 backwards + 38 duplicate flags) and EXP009/R02 (24 flags), and out-of-scope records (recipe/controller, probe/fit configuration, calibration, raw replicates) that keep several hypotheses unconfirmed. Advisory severity LOW; no disposition, release, CAPA or manufacturing action is proposed.

report.cross_scope_synthesis: Shared structure: all 12 experiments (24 runs) export the same 8-sheet layout with elapsed-hours clocks from 0; inline streams (CO2, Permittivity, ProcessParameters, Turbidity) sample every 30-60 s (10,000-40,000 rows) and offline assays (CellAnalysis 12-23 rows; MediumAnalysis 7-23 rows) sample every 1-3 days, so offline-to-inline mapping is fundamentally a sparse-to-dense join on one shared clock. Where clocks are clean the join is exact: 14/15 and 21+1/23 samples aligned at zero-to-15-second offsets (EXP001/R01, EXP001/R02, EXP010/R01), and the only unmatched samples sit past the end of the inline streams (~5.7 h tail in EXP001), not at clock disagreements. Shared exceptions: (1) EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 all carry zero-filled Cole-fit channels (18 C frequencies, Alpha, DeltaEps, RMSE, R2, fc constant 0) while Conductivity and Permittivity stay live - a per-run fitting/export gap, unique to three R02 runs, that removes frequency-resolved permittivity mapping but not broadband mapping. (2) Backwards source-time steps appear in 362 series across 12 of 24 runs, from single steps (most runs, shown non-obstructive in EXP001) to 8-9 (EXP002/R02) and 40-row staircases with zero-dropout segments (EXP003/R01, verified cell C14871=0 before recovery at C14872); EXP004 shows the broadest flags (CO2, ProcessParameters, NaOH included, 38 duplicate timestamps) and remains unresolved. (3) First-row zero initialization and last-row endpoint zeros recur across online/inline series (feed, NaOH, aeration O2, CO2 fraction): endpoints are log endpoints and do not prove process cessation. Batch vs fed-batch is the main operating-mode split: EXP001-009 feed weight is constant 0.0 while EXP010-012 feed live to 857.3/817.4/228.5/11.4/274.4/281.9 g; within EXP011 the two duplicate runs diverge sharply (R01 228.53 g vs R02 11.42 g with logging stopped at t=67.14 h, and R02's offline glucose stops at t=67 h in the same window). Biology-side pattern: two runs show terminal viability collapse at the final offline sample (EXP001/R01 VCD 46,000 with viability 0.28 percent and TCD 16.5M; EXP011/R02 VCD 0, viability 0, TCD 5.8M) while inline permittivity in EXP001/R01 stayed high (~11 pF/cm) into the decline - the package cannot separate real terminal death from assay/export artifacts, and inline permittivity may track total biovolume rather than viable cells. Limits: reported Mean/SEM offline columns have no raw replicates in scope; no recipe, controller, calibration or acquisition-log evidence exists in the package, so setpoints (100 rpm agitation, feed strategy), sign conventions (EXP005 Reflection), and clock-reset causes remain hypotheses; per-run alignment was demonstrated on 4 of 24 runs and the clock-disordered runs (EXP002/R02, EXP003, EXP004, EXP009/R02, EXP012/R02) need ordered re-alignment before their mappings are trusted.

open_questions: Why are all Cole-fit channels (18 C frequencies, Alpha, DeltaEps, fit RMSE/R2, fc) exactly 0.0 across EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while Conductivity and Permittivity remain live?

What is the exact structure of the backwards clock steps (reset to zero vs small step-back, duplicate timestamps, affected segments) in EXP003/R01+R02, EXP002/R02, EXP004/R01+R02, EXP009/R02 and EXP012/R02?
Why does EXP011/R02 feed logging stop at t=67.14 h at 11.42 g while duplicate run EXP011/R01 records 228.53 g, and is it linked to the offline Glucose series stopping at t=67.0 h in the same run?
Why do offline Glucose/Lactate series stop early in several runs (EXP011/R02 glucose 67 h, lactate 148.5 h; EXP012/R02 glucose 91 h vs 219 h run end)?
Is the terminal VCD/viability zero at the final offline sample of EXP011/R02 (and the near-zero of EXP001/R01) a real viability collapse or a final-sample assay/export artifact?
Are the last-row zeros in EXP009/R01 Aeration rate O2, EXP010/R02 CO2 fraction inlet and EXP001/R02 cumulative NaOH log endpoints or process events?
Are constant 100 rpm agitation records in EXP008-EXP012 fixed setpoints, and are the 971-3000 rpm spikes in EXP001-EXP004/EXP007 real control actions or sensor artifacts?
Which sign convention is correct for EXP005 turbidity Reflection (R01 all <= 0 vs R02 positive)?
Individual inline-to-offline alignment has been demonstrated for 4 of 24 runs; the remaining 20 runs share the structure but were not aligned in this pass.
Replicate-level cell counts for EXP011/R02 rows 14-18 are not in the package: 'all replicates zero' vs 'failed count entered as zero' cannot be fully separated.

Why did glucose entries stop at EXP009/R01 t=88, EXP011/R01 t=148.5, EXP011/R02 t=67 and EXP012/R02 t=91 (and lactate at EXP009/R01 t=167, EXP011/R02 t=148.5) while ammonium/osmolality continued? No assay log, SOP or operator-note evidence is in scope.
What is the biological or operational cause of the EXP011 viability collapse, and why do the duplicate runs diverge (R02 collapsed by t~90-148, R01 declining only after t~160)?
For EXP001/R02, was NaOH/feed genuinely not delivered (batch operation) or did the weight channels fail to record? No pump, inventory or calibration evidence is in scope.
When and why did the EXP009/R01 O2-enrichment and EXP010/R02 CO2-inlet phases go to zero? Recipe/controller records are not in the scoped observations.
Root cause of the 30-s time inversions (sensor firmware vs data-system export): no controller/export log evidence is in the scoped package.
Do the EXP003 staircase rows carry duplicated measurement values from the first pass through 141.4-141.9 h, or fresh re-measurements?

Both EXP003 runs show their staircase at nearly the same elapsed region (~141.4-141.9 h) although they are separate runs; run start calendars are not in scope, so a shared external event can neither be confirmed nor excluded.
EXP012/R02 turbidity shows 0 steps while its permittivity file shows 1 - whether the two files use independent clock paths is unresolved (contrast with shared step rows in EXP002/R02).
